```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

ROOT <- normalizePath(getwd())

while (!(dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "analysis_r")) &&
         dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "data")))) {

  parent <- dirname(ROOT)

  if (parent == ROOT) {
    stop("Open the project folder first.")
  }

  ROOT <- parent
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ROOT)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE
)

OUTPUT <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "06_report"
)

FIGURES <- file.path(
  OUTPUT,
  "figures"
)

dir.create(
  FIGURES,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

handoff_paths <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  c(
    "03_consistency/profile_handoff.rds",
    "04_comparisons/comparison_handoff.rds",
    "05_nfl_translation/nfl_translation_handoff.rds"
  )
)

if (!all(file.exists(handoff_paths))) {
  stop("Complete and save Rmds 03, 04, and 05 first.")
}

profiles <- readRDS(handoff_paths[1])
comparison <- readRDS(handoff_paths[2])
nfl <- readRDS(handoff_paths[3])

primary <- nfl$tables$primary_comparison
uncertainty <- nfl$tables$primary_conditional_interval
context <- nfl$tables$context_comparison
metrics <- nfl$tables$model_metrics
sensitivities <- nfl$tables$sample_sensitivities

agreement <- profiles$consistency_tables$peak_agreement_by_position

selected <- comparison$selected_players
selected_peaks <- comparison$crossing_aligned_peaks

if (primary$rmse_gain >= 0 ||
    context$rmse_gain >= 0 ||
    any(sensitivities$rmse_gain >= 0) ||
    uncertainty$conditional_gain_p975 >= 0) {
  stop("Result directions changed. Revise the narrative before rendering.")
}

fmt <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  formatC(
    x,
    format = "f",
    digits = digits
  )
}

observed_range <- function(x, digits = 3) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return("Unavailable")
  }

  paste(
    fmt(min(x), digits),
    fmt(max(x), digits),
    sep = " to "
  )
}

reference_rmse <- metrics |>
  filter(
    analysis == "Primary: at least 10 NFL routes",
    model == "Year reference"
  ) |>
  pull(rmse)

interior_times <- selected_peaks$peak_time_from_speed_crossing_s[
  !selected_peaks$peak_at_search_boundary
]

source_figures <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "04_comparisons",
  "figures",
  c(
    "full_recorded_speed.png",
    "crossing_aligned_speed.png"
  )
)

if (!all(file.exists(source_figures))) {
  stop("Save the comparison figures in Rmd 04 first.")
}

copied_figures <- file.copy(
  from = source_figures,
  to = file.path(
    FIGURES,
    c(
      "01_speed.png",
      "02_aligned_speed.png"
    )
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

if (!all(copied_figures)) {
  stop("Could not copy the comparison figures.")
}
```

## What does the stopwatch leave out?

`r paste(selected$display_name, collapse = ", ")` share a published `r fmt(comparison$settings$official_forty_s, 2)`-second 40. Does that mean they build speed in the same way?

This project examines recorded speed development, observed acceleration peaks, and repeated-attempt agreement within Combine position groups. A separate receiver analysis asks whether a speed-building interval improves prediction of early NFL route movement beyond traditional testing results.

The distinction matters: identifying different recorded profiles is a descriptive finding. Establishing useful NFL prediction requires an additional test.

## Data and measurement

The Combine cohort contains `r nrow(profiles$player_roster)` players and `r nrow(profiles$named_peaks)` recordings from 2023–2025, covering DB, DL, OL, TE,
